correctness.rationale: Product of triangular circumballs plus at most one terminal interval contains the polytope; two feasible antipodal points attain 2R and force unique center; strict convexity reduces contacts to product vertices; even-index inequalities classify them by independent sets or the s=1 exceptions; complementarity counts antipodal pairs. The proof is parametric, including d=2 and both parities. Exact integer checks pass on 28 parameter pairs.
